bullets_en: IMD issued a weather alert for Telangana, reports suggest.
DMK president Stalin has sought immediate resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.
Karnataka agrees to release water to Telangana’s Jurala project in phases.
Telangana HC seeks compliance report on Ganesh noise curbs.
Jagan complains to Governor on DSC-2025 ‘irregularities’, seeks CBI probe.
bullets_ur: Reports ke mutabiq IMD ne Telangana ke liye mausam ka alert jaari kiya.

Karnataka ne paani Telangana’s Jurala project ko phases mein chhodenge.
Telangana HC ne compliance report Ganesh noise curbs par ki maang ki.
